\caption{Fraction of rows ($n = 20$ instances, all seeds, OPT by brute force) on which a published monotone upper bound, or an ablation of the dual bound, falls below OPT$_k$, as a function of $k$. M1: BQS Dual; M2: Marginal without penalty; M3: Zhang--Tang--Tang $\Lambda^{3*}$ with nonnegative (literal) or free (favorable) increments, rates over the rows where its LP is feasible; A1: the dual bound without its penalty; A2: the dual bound with the raw prefix caps $f_S(A_i)$. The controls (top-$k$, Marginal, dual bound, B2, B5) never violate.}
\label{fig:violations-by-k}
